# Kinetype sentence source (hand-written).
#
# One sentence per line, lowercase a-z and single spaces only. No punctuation, no
# digits, no proper nouns. Blank lines and # comments are ignored; longer lines are
# wrapped for reading only, never in the data.
#
# scripts/build-sentences.py validates every line and sorts it into a band by total
# character count, then writes game/sentences.ts. scripts/validate-sentences.py
# re-checks the generated file.
#
# Rules the build enforces:
#   - 4 to 11 words, 16 to 62 characters
#   - no word longer than 12 characters
#   - every sentence contains at least one block word (3 characters or fewer) and at
#     least one punch word (4 to 7 characters), so every sentence can both defend and
#     attack
#   - no profanity, brands, web noise, abbreviations or lowercased proper nouns
#   - this game is played in classrooms, so the bar is "a teacher would be fine with it"

# --------------------------------------------- sentences that carry a kick word
# A kick needs an eight-letter word, which a short sentence only fits if the word is
# chosen for it. Without these, a player on the slow bot speeds never throws a kick
# and can never land the knockout blow the game is built around.
my keyboard is on the desk
the mountain is cold at dawn
we climb the mountain at dawn
the sandwich is in my lunch bag
she got a birthday card
